name: AR_CUST_UPD_ERRMSG_MAP
description: AR_CUST_UPD_ERRMSG_MAP contains mapping information for error messages raised during the customer bulk import process.

columns.name: ERR_MSG_MAP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the error message mapping table.

columns.name: UPLOAD_OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Receivables interface table that stores customer import data.

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Associated interface table for the error message to be mapped.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Original error message in Receivables and Trading Community Module that is mapped to a new error message in the AR_MAPPED_ERROR_MESSAGE column.

columns.name: TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN2_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN2_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN3_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN3_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN4_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN4_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN5_NAME
columns.description: Token name for the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN5_VALUE
columns.description: Token value for the error message.

columns.name: CONTACT_POINT_TYPE
columns.description: Contact point type. Values are from the lookup CONTACT_POINT_TYPE. For examples, phone, fax, e-mail, web, telex, instant messaging, or EDI.

columns.name: PHONE_LINE_TYPE
columns.description: Values of the PHONE_LINE_TYPE lookup, such as general, fax, inbound, or outbound.

columns.name: AR_MAPPED_ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: New Receivables error message that maps to the original error message of the interface table in the INTERFACE_TABLE_NAME column.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
